WORK_RESEARCH.intent: Study complete food works for focal scale, appetite, silence, rhythm and visual restraint.

RADAR.intent: Collect concrete meal moments with enough context to render a believable food state.

EDITORIAL.intent: Choose one sensory change or eating moment without forcing story-comic reversal or recipe exposition.

STORYBOARD.intent: Design sensory-route body beats, food-state transitions, meal-scene continuity, hands/utensils, focal areas, silent beats, and a separate product-cover brief.

ASSET_PRODUCTION.intent: Bind actual meal/style references and render physically/culturally coherent body states while preserving declared meal-scene state and per-shot deltas.

COMPOSITION.intent: Keep body lettering editable, protect the food focal area, and assemble the separate Instagram cover from the child cover template using reuse-first approved assets.

QC.intent: Check food state, meal-scene/table continuity, contact geometry, meal context, sensory readability, cover/body role separation, and lettering separately.
